text: Residents have reached out to my office with concerns about road safety and speeding along Parkview Hill Crescent. To keep making our community safer for all, I recommend installing an all-way stop at the intersection of Parkview Hill Crescent and Presteign Avenue.
The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Authorized all-way stop controls at the intersection of Parkview Hill Crescent and Presteign Avenue.
